name: Fluffal Wings
effectText: If you control "Toy Vendor": You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 "Fluffal" monster in your GY; banish it, and if you do, draw 1 card, then you can send 1 "Toy Vendor" you control to the GY, and if you do, draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Fluffal Wings" once per turn.
